deploy-bot: Migration job queued — env=prod tag=v2.3.1-rc3 commit=b7f9c3a job=migrate-schema-2026-03-20 strategy=staggered-canary
jessica: good to see staggered canaries. which shards first? any exclusive locks?
kara: canary order: users -> orders -> billing. migrations use ONLINE index builds where supported, no exclusive locks expected. I'll watch replication lag.
marco: @kara can you keep an eye on replica-2 lag? last release it spiked during index build.
deploy-bot: Canary 1/3 starting on shard=users node=db-w-2 exec_id=mx-987
sam: ETA on canary duration? we should set 10m timeout per canary.
kara: expecting ~2-4m for users, will abort if lag > 5s or error seen.
deploy-bot: Canary 1/3 finished — shard=users status=success duration=165s
jessica: nice. updating release notes with a short entry about the new users index and cache-warm step.
deploy-bot: Canary 2/3 starting on shard=orders node=db-w-4 exec_id=mx-988
kara: orders migration includes concurrent index build on orders.created_at — watching for replication lag.
deploy-bot: Canary 2/3 failed — shard=orders error="concurrent index build timeout" details=\"index build timed out after 300s\"
marco: aborting rollout. rolling back canaries and pinning deploy to v2.3.0 until we triage. @deploy-bot start revert job and mark release window as paused. :warning:
sam: +1. please note in release notes that orders index caused failure, postponing GA.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated — running revert script revert_20260320_07.sql on env=prod
kara: running revert now. since it failed on index build, revert is a no-op for data but we need to undo the alter statements and ensure schema parity.
kara: snippet of what I'm running:
```bash
./migrate --db=prod --run revert_20260320_07.sql --timeout=600
# logs follow
```
deploy-bot: Revert job finished — status=success duration=42s
marco: thanks everyone. action items: 1) open postmortem about index timeout and index tuning testing 2) create a smaller canary with a single replica for orders 3) pin prod to v2.3.0 and re-run when we have mitigation. I'll create the JIRA.
jessica: I updated release-notes/drafts with the pause note and the rollback bullet.
sam: added a replication-lag alert tweak to the rollout playbook (increase sensitivity during index builds).
kara: I'll re-run the orders migration with increased timeout + background build testing in staging. Will report back tomorrow morning.
marco: OK closing this thread — thanks for the quick rollback and clear updates. :thumbsup:
